tasks.title: ICP: healthcare credentialing / RCM buyers
tasks.prompt: Find 8 public, named mid-size healthcare groups / RCM shops (US) with a real contact path (site, LinkedIn, billing page). Pain: denials, days-in-AR, credentialing backlog. Output JSON: company, city, role, observable, why-pay, checkout=https://getsincor.com/products/starter. No DeFi. No invented emails. Public sources only.
